Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From b8f8dbf6495850b0babc551377bde754b7bc0eea Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Thomas Zimmermann <tzimmermann@suse.de>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2020 16:25:36 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] drm/vram-helper: Fix use of top-down placement
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Commit 7053e0eab473 ("drm/vram-helper: stop using TTM placement flags")
cleared the BO placement flags if top-down placement had been selected.
Hence, BOs that were supposed to go into VRAM are now placed in a default
location in system memory.

Trying to scanout the incorrectly pinned BO results in displayed garbage
and an error message.

[  146.108127] 
diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_gem_vram_helper.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_gem_vram_helper.c
index 50cad0e4a92e..375c79e23ca5 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_gem_vram_helper.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_gem_vram_helper.c
@@ -140,7 +140,7 @@ static void drm_gem_vram_placement(struct drm_gem_vram_object *gbo,
 	unsigned int c = 0;
 
 	if (pl_flag & DRM_GEM_VRAM_PL_FLAG_TOPDOWN)
-		pl_flag = TTM_PL_FLAG_TOPDOWN;
+		invariant_flags = TTM_PL_FLAG_TOPDOWN;
 
 	gbo->placement.placement = gbo->placements;
 	gbo->placement.busy_placement = gbo->placements;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/drm_gem_vram_helper.c`**
   - The line that previously set `pl_flag` to `TTM_PL_FLAG_TOPDOWN` when the top-down placement flag was active has been changed. 
   - Instead of modifying `pl_flag`, the patch now assigns `TTM_PL_FLAG_TOPDOWN` to `invariant_flags`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `drm_gem_vram_helper.c` addresses a bug introduced in a previous commit (7053e0eab473) that incorrectly cleared the buffer object (BO) placement flags when top-down placement was selected. By changing the assignment from `pl_flag` to `invariant_flags`, the patch ensures that BOs intended for VRAM are correctly flagged, preventing them from being placed in the default system memory location. This fix is crucial for avoiding display issues and errors when attempting to use the incorrectly pinned BOs.
